aboutSubheading: From one sparky to a full team
aboutText: Established in 1997 by Director Michael in Hoppers Crossing, MCF Electrical Services has grown from a sole operator to a team of 10 qualified electricians and apprentices. We've spent 25 years delivering trusted, high-standard electrical services to homes and businesses across Victoria, with our local roots firmly in the western suburbs.
servicesText: From critical compliance testing to complete system installations, we provide a full suite of electrical services. Our team is equipped to handle residential, commercial, and emergency work with precision and professionalism.

services.title: Split System Supply & Installation
services.desc: Expert installation and supply of split system air conditioners to keep your home comfortable year-round.

services.title: Pre-purchase Compliance Testing
services.desc: Thorough electrical safety and compliance inspections for property purchases across Victoria.

services.title: Test & Tag Compliance Solutions
services.desc: Mandatory safety testing and tagging of portable electrical appliances for businesses and workplaces.

services.title: Thermal Imaging Surveys
services.desc: Advanced thermal imaging to detect hotspots, electrical faults, and potential failures before they occur.

services.title: General Electrical Maintenance
services.desc: Skilled fault-finding, repairs, and upgrades for all domestic and commercial electrical systems.

services.title: 24/7 Emergency Electrical Callouts
services.desc: Fast, reliable emergency response for urgent electrical failures, available across Melbourne's west.
